title: Fixes in Excel reports for Aged Accounts.
summary: Aged Accounts Excel reports now properly handle customers and vendors with historical balances outside the selected date range and correctly assign transactions to aging buckets.
key_points: Added a new aging bucket from 0D to cover all historical activity before the main period
Fixed bucket assignment logic for ending dates by using index-based retrieval instead of descending list comparison
Removed due date filter to include all outstanding balances regardless of due date status
Filtering for customers/vendors without due balance now considers full history, not just the selected period
Added comprehensive tests for historical balances, bucket assignment, and not-yet-due transactions
quote: The aged buckets were not covering the whole history for a customer, only bounded to the end date supplied.
